messages: Hi, I tried to pay my mobile bill of 230.00 SAR through the app and it said the transaction was declined. I checked my card and nothing was deducted. Reference TXN-48213. Can you tell me why?
Hello, I cancelled my order ORD-77120 for the 5G home router before it shipped. Please refund the 349.00 SAR I paid.
Thank you for contacting us. Can you confirm the payment method used?
It was my Mada card ending 4471.
I can't log in to my account. When I enter my number, the OTP never arrives by SMS. I tried five times this afternoon.
Sorry for the trouble. Are you receiving other SMS messages normally?
Yes, other messages come through fine, just not the login code.
Since 7 this morning I have no calls, no SMS and no mobile data at all. The phone shows No Service. My neighbors in Al-Nakheel, Riyadh have the same problem. I restarted the phone twice already.
My new SIM card delivery, order ORD-55018, was supposed to arrive on Tuesday. It's Friday and nothing yet. The tracking page hasn't updated since Monday.
We apologize for the delay. Let me check with the courier.
Thanks, please let me know when to expect it.
My plan is 150 SAR per month but this month's invoice INV-2026-10-3381 is 189.75 SAR. I did add a roaming pack when I traveled to Bahrain. Is that the reason for the difference?
Hi, do you support eSIM for the Apple Watch? And can I share my existing number with it?

Your bill is due on the 15th of each month.
Great, thank you.

Good evening! Thank you for contacting us, how can I help?

I have opened case CASE-70512 for you. The lock will be lifted after identity verification.
Thanks. Also is it going to rain this weekend in Riyadh? Just kidding, have a nice day.

Thanks for letting us know. Could you try the payment again with another card?
I'll try, but I'd like to know why the first one was declined.

I received an OTP SMS I never requested, and five minutes later I saw a purchase of 2,349.00 SAR from my wallet at an online electronics store. Reference PAY-781336. I did not make this purchase. Please freeze my wallet.

This is urgent, we are securing your account. Are you at a safe location to verify your identity?
Yes, please hurry, my wallet is linked to this number.
I paid my bill of 560.00 SAR once, but I was charged twice. The second charge is a duplicate of transaction TXN-55190. Please refund the extra 560.00 SAR.
We're sorry about this. We can see two charges and will investigate.
Please be quick, that money was for rent.
